description: A flow resumed from a checkpoint reads its intent from the checkpoint's stored context, not from the intent file given on the command line. When the checkpoint predates a change to the intent text (for example the self-explaining-code sentence in the goal), the resumed stages judge and execute against the stale goal, and the invariant is silently dropped. A resumed executor then wrote docstrings that the review loop did not flag because the goal it saw lacked the rule.
goal: When 'holon flow' resumes from a checkpoint and an intent file is supplied, refresh the restored context's intent text (goal, description, rationale, scope and acceptance criteria) from the intent file, never touching branch, slug or id fields, log one line per field that changed, and refuse the resume with a clear error when the resulting goal lacks the self-explaining-code sentence. Put the logic in one new small module and call it from the existing helper that already applies this run's arguments to the restored context, without editing the flow command module. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: The goal is the contract the executor and reviewers judge against; a resume must use the current contract, and a missing invariant must stop the resume instead of passing quietly.
acceptance_criteria: intent_refresh.py replaces goal, description, rationale, scope and acceptance criteria in a restored context from the intent file and leaves branch, slug and parent fields untouched; test_intent_refresh_on_resume.py proves it with a checkpoint context whose goal lacks the self-explaining sentence (the real failure) and an intent file that has it.
The same test file proves a resume with an intent file whose goal lacks the self-explaining sentence is refused with a clear message, and that a resume without an intent file is unchanged.

cli/commands/_flow_resume.py calls the refresh from apply_run_switches or an equivalent existing helper both resume paths already run; cli/commands/flow.py and flow/lazy_exports.py are not edited, and a test shows both resume paths refresh. tests/flow/test_resume_checkpoint.py keeps passing.

No docstrings and no comments except '# why:' in anything added; every new module is at most 200 lines; holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged; 'uv run pytest' on the new and touched tests, 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass. The new module sits directly in the sandbox_executor package, not under flow/, so no package re-export file is edited.
